resources.string: Listen to a song interval through SOURCE at the same pitch. Practice does not change your song, Undo history or export. Stop restores the original SOURCE without restarting it.
The selected and slowed audio must each fit within 30 seconds (up to 18 seconds selected at 0.6×). Loop edges blend for up to 10 ms without shortening the period. Settings last for this panel only.
Enter a valid interval and speed within the 30-second limits.
Choose an interval inside the arranged song.
